description: Defines a thread-safe blocking queue class template with both dynamic and static buffer implementations, including internal base class with push/pop operations, synchronization, and stop control.

classes.name: base_blocking_queue
classes.description: A template class implementing a thread-safe, blocking and non-blocking queue with internal ring buffer, supporting stop and synchronization.

classes.name: blocking_queue
classes.description: A dynamic buffer implementation of the blocking queue with configurable size.

classes.name: static_blocking_queue
classes.description: A static buffer implementation of the blocking queue with fixed size at compile time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Sets the queue to inactive state and notifies all waiting threads.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_push (range)
methods.description: Attempts to push a range of elements into the queue.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes an element into the queue, blocking if full until space is available or inactive.

methods.name: push_blocking (range)
methods.description: Pushes a range of elements into the queue, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop an element without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop (range)
methods.description: Attempts to pop a range of elements.

methods.name: pop_blocking
methods.description: Pops an element, blocking if empty until an element is available or inactive.

methods.name: pop_blocking (range)
methods.description: Pops a range of elements, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: pop_wait_for
methods.description: Pops an element, waiting up to a specified duration.

methods.name: pop_wait_until
methods.description: Pops an element, waiting until a specified time point.

methods.name: pop_and_discard_until
methods.description: Pops and discards elements until a stop condition is met.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Checks if the queue is full.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.

methods.name: is_stopped
methods.description: Checks if the queue has been stopped/inactive.

methods.name: try_call_on_front
methods.description: Applies a callable to the front element if available.

methods.name: apply_first
methods.description: Applies a callable to elements until the callable returns false.
